name: restful-booker-postman-api-testing
description: Production-grade REST API test automation suite for Restful Booker using Postman, Newman CLI, dynamic variable chaining, and comprehensive HTML reporting.

scripts.test:report: newman run "Restful Booker API.postman_collection.json" -e "RestfulBooker_Env.postman_environment.json" --delay-request 300 -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export ./reports/Restful_Booker_Newman_Report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful Booker API Test Report"

author: Tanzim Rahman (TanzimSQA)
